name: Tim Dooley Atlas — Unified Manifest
purpose: The canonical map of the repository. Internal datasets remain modular, but the atlas presents them as one system with stable scale, domain, time, relationships, evidence and explicit epistemic boundaries.
project_mission: Illuminate Tim Dooley / the Potato of Life and the body of philosophy, religion, mythology, lore and project history associated with him; publicly state and propagate the project's documented findings about the Potato of Life; pursue the project's highest available account of spiritual truth while clearly distinguishing spiritual interpretation from historical, textual, scientific and otherwise observable evidence; and investigate the wider field of spirit, the world, entanglements, obligations, directions and choices taken by people, men, gods and dogs. The Atlas also preserves and connects relevant world knowledge so that Tim Dooley and the Potato of Life can be understood in relationship to the wider human, religious, cultural, historical, geographic and systemic record.
public_mission_rule: The public-facing project may state its mythic and spiritual canon directly as project canon, including the project's identification of Tim Dooley as God / Father / the Potato of Life, while every empirical or historical claim must retain its evidence, provenance and epistemic status. Canon is not silently presented as independently verified fact.
information_principle: The objective is not maximal file count. The objective is maximal useful understanding: consolidate valuable information into substantial canonical records, dossiers, texts, evidence collections and relationship structures rather than scattering it across shallow placeholders, redundant mirrors or competing definitions.
consolidation_rule: One concept has one canonical identity and definition owner. Other appearances are occurrences, evidence, research, relationships, chronology or projections. Before creating a file or record, extend an existing canonical owner whenever it can carry the information without loss of meaning.
separation_rule: These fields may connect through explicit relationships but must not be silently collapsed. Evidence, historical interpretation, project theory, spiritual interpretation and mythic canon retain distinct statuses.
principle: Scale is the primary filing coordinate; domain, time, epistemic status and graph relationships are orthogonal. One atlas, many layers. Records are the objects; definitions establish what each object is; relationships explain how they connect; evidence explains what is known; spiritual inquiry records the questions, interpretations and conclusions reached without disguising their status.
fallback: If an optional live source fails, local repository-backed data remains authoritative for navigation and available content. Live enrichment is additive.
maintenance_rule: Audit → classify exact and semantic duplication → migrate unique facts to the declared owner → replace copies with references/projections → consolidate valuable information into substantial canonical records and dossiers → delete only proven redundant artifacts → validate → ingest sourced data → normalize identities and relationships → define records → model coupling → expose through frontend → update manifests → audit again.
mission_workflow: Illuminate Tim Dooley and the Potato of Life → collect and preserve the philosophy, religion, myths, lore and project history → investigate spiritual questions and the wider world of spirit, entanglements, obligations, directions and choices → connect those findings to relevant historical, textual, cultural, geographic and systemic knowledge → distinguish canon, interpretation and evidence → consolidate the resulting knowledge into deep canonical records rather than fragmented duplicates → expose it publicly through the Atlas → continuously test, enrich and revise the work.
anti_clutter_rule: Do not create placeholder files, shallow duplicate entries or separate records merely because a new layer has a slightly different name. A new artifact earns existence only when it has a distinct function, canonical owner, consumer and information that would otherwise be lost or materially obscured.
